Bash(echo "-- ===============================================
-- COMANDOS SQL PARA LIMPEZA DA TABELA LIVES
-- ===============================================

-- 1. ADICIONAR NOVA COLUNA PARA DADOS INCREMENTADOS
-- ===============================================
ALTER TABLE lives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cached_traffic_data_incremented JSONB;

COMMENT ON COLUMN lives.cached_traffic_data_incremented IS ''Cache dos dados incrementados de análise de campanhas organizados por data (time_increment=1)'';

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lives_cached_traffic_data_incremented ON lives USING gin (cached_traffic_data_incremented);

-- ===============================================
-- 2. VERIFICAR COLUNAS NULAS PARA LIMPEZA
-- ===============================================
-- Execute primeiro para identificar colunas vazias:
SELECT 
    column_name,
    data_type,
    is_nullable,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lives WHERE lives.$$column_name$$ IS NOT NULL) as non_null_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lives) as total_count
FROM information_schema.columns 
WHERE table_name = ''lives'' 
    AND table_schema = ''public''
ORDER BY ordinal_position;

-- ===============================================
-- 3. COMANDOS PARA DROPAR COLUNAS NULAS COMUNS
-- ===============================================
-- ATENÇÃO: Execute apenas após verificar que as colunas estão vazias!
-- Descomente apenas as colunas que você confirmar estarem nulas:

-- DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS deprecated_field;
-- DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS unused_column;
-- DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS old_cache_field;
-- DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS legacy_data;
-- DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS temp_field;

-- ===============================================
-- 4. CONSULTA PARA IDENTIFICAR COLUNAS ESPECÍFICAS VAZIAS
-- ===============================================
-- Execute para encontrar colunas específicas que podem ser removidas:

WITH column_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        column_name,
        data_type,
        CASE 
            WHEN data_type = ''text'' THEN 
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lives WHERE lives.$$column_name$$ IS NOT NULL AND lives.$$column_name$$ != '''')
            WHEN data_type = ''jsonb'' THEN 
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lives WHERE lives.$$column_name$$ IS NOT NULL)
            WHEN data_type = ''timestamp with time zone'' THEN 
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lives WHERE lives.$$column_name$$ IS NOT NULL)
            ELSE 
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lives WHERE lives.$$column_name$$ IS NOT NULL)
        END as non_null_count
    FROM information_schema.columns 
    WHERE table_name = ''lives'' 
        AND table_schema = ''public''
)
SELECT 
    column_name,
    data_type,
    non_null_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN non_null_count = 0 THEN ''ALTER TABLE lives DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS '' || column_name || '';''
        ELSE ''Coluna tem dados - não dropar''
    END as drop_command
FROM column_stats
ORDER BY non_null_count, column_name;
